restaurantName: Kwan Kee Clay Pot Rice (Queen's Road West)
address: Shop 1, GF, Wo Yick Mansion, 263 Queen's Road West, Sai Ying Pun, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Its red sign, basic interior and traditional stir-fries all point to an authentic Hong Kong food experience. Claypot rice is only served at night and takes time to prepare, so order it first as soon as you’re seated. The three-rice blend results in a chewy texture and appealing fragrance; the bottom crust is always perfectly scorched. The white eel variety is especially popular; pair it with claypot dishes with excellent wok hei....
